content.text: Boardsmith Prototype: Executive Summary
Boardsmith is a modern, AI-enhanced board governance platform for SMEs, start-ups, and nonprofits, aiming to streamline board communication, enhance compliance, and save time.
1. Platform Foundation & AI Capabilities
The prototype focuses on validating the platform architecture and core AI agent integration using RAG and LLM-based flows.
LLM experimentation with text/image inputs (excluding audio/video).
Full-context document ingestion and feedback system with scoring (clarity, relevance, insight).
Pyramid Principle and MECE frameworks tested via prompt templates.
2. Core UX Features & Workflow
Boardsmith includes end-to-end UX for agenda-based document creation, AI generation, and editing.
Dashboard for creating/viewing board papers.
Agenda builder with document upload and prompt-driven AI copilot.
Edit Mode with inline suggestions and AI-based rewrite options.
Presentation Mode that converts text to summary visuals.
3. Technical Stack & Infrastructure
Built using modern frameworks and cloud-native deployment.
Frontend: React (Next.js), Tailwind CSS
Backend: Express, PostgreSQL (via Supabase), Vector DB
AI: n8n workflow engine + RAG + TBD LLMs
Hosting: Vercel (CI/CD via GitHub Actions)
4. Next Steps & Roadmap
Finalize prototype scope, select LLM vendor, and estimate for MVP implementation.
